contract: GPU correctness belongs in universal core behavior. No title/shader/vendor/host exception, per-game option, or readback-policy override.
changes: GPU-written buffer pages automatically acquire read watches; CPU access uses existing synchronized buffer download and partial-write preservation regardless of legacy settings.
Page protection is no-access while a read watcher exists, including when no CPU-write watcher exists; never issue invalid write-only protection.
Use the existing signal/fault tracking implementation because the present userfaultfd backend only observes writes. The legacy userfaultfd request is logged as insufficient, not silently used.

Eligible GPU-written linear/tiny images automatically enter existing OnSubmit/OnFence publication; eligibility and download implementation are retained, with a nonzero-address guard for render targets.
Remove readback controls from the UI and override list. Legacy serialized fields remain loadable but have no renderer consumers. Remove the proposed SHADPS4_TEST_PRECISE_READBACKS runner override.
Log automatic core policy and bounded actual buffer/image publication events when diagnostics are requested; copied user configurations retain existing readback values.
Fair shader capture takes one complete binary/SPIR-V pair per priority hash before extra permutations; resource-clamp hashes join priorities, with existing byte/file limits.

upstream_integration.resolution: Retain existing functional NGS2 lifecycle/decoder/mixer and bridge upstream public ABI/Impl entrypoints to it. Upstream silence-only rendering/separate registry implementation is superseded by the retained HLE; not a claim that every upstream lifecycle semantic is identical. All six current upstream NGS2 cases pass against the retained production implementation.

Rebase retained universal fixes and source evidence onto upstream 2183807e

Preserves the exact integration and audit tree from PRs #118 and #119, with upstream libSceJpegDec #5607 integrated. Original reviewed commits remain available on their existing branches. Native game rendering is not promoted by this rebase.

Restore generic indexed descriptor sampling from recovered source

Recover exact descriptor masks, finite direct Phi sources, dynamic scalar buffer reads and GPU-indexed image/sampler arrays. Preserve retained ordered-GDS capture, bounded uniform stores, DMA synchronization and upstream changes. Use complete dimension-array capacities and exact Vulkan limits; recompile when table size changes. Reject unsupported numeric/dimension/conversion cases explicitly.

Local source tree 966ff989684d10b56054f0ac2c5d04f18cc51380 builds with GCC 14. Production resource discovery passes 12 checks; five backend shaders pass spirv-val for Vulkan 1.3. Native GoT/GoW graphics remain unverified.

Journal recovered renderer lineage and native build validation

Verify 678 captured source hashes and four exact historical file matches. Preserve protected binary identities and append all preparation/build/fixture outcomes. Native game graphics and DS continuation remain unverified; no main promotion.

limits: No native execution of this automatic-coherence candidate. GoT black screen and GoW GPU loss remain unresolved until tested.
Historical readback-mode mismatch is established, but its causal contribution to the two game regressions is not proven.
Existing image eligibility is retained; arbitrary tiled-image CPU reads and asynchronous GPU/CPU races are not established by these checks.
Signal handlers on Windows/macOS and native performance across GPUs still require execution; no all-systems/all-games success claim.
DS ordered code is retained but dedicated seed and guest re-entry remain unfinished; no ordered capture in the latest archive.

Require actual automatic marker and publication evidence; stop after GPU failure or unconfirmed child exit. Preserve >=8GiB VRAM and existing-session checks.
